content: Vinted catalog URLs use query params: catalog[]=ID, price_from, price_to, currency=EUR, order=newest_first, search_text, brand_ids[], status_ids[]. Category IDs appear in path form /catalog/{id}-{slug}. No native latitude/longitude/city_id URL filter on vinted.it; geo filtering must be post-extract via seller location. price_to=0 does not reliably restrict results to zero-price items in live testing.
